blocks.text: After breakfast, excursion to the Perito Moreno Glacier, one of the most accessible glaciers in the world, in a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Its ice front rises about 60 metres above the water and can be admired from numerous viewpoints along the shore. Every few years the glacier blocks the channel between Lago Argentino and Brazo Rico; the water builds up, carves a tunnel through the ice and, over two to three days, the arch finally collapses with a thunderous roar. Bring a packed lunch; there is also a restaurant in the park.
